items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: And so at that time Papa Charlie Jackson was going big with the, he's playing the guitar and singing Uncle Bud and all them type of blues. And so Melrose had a lot of confidence in me... He says, but he says, can't you get something together, something like Papa Charlie Jackson

ctx.x: He was running short of wax, this, that, and the other.

So I kept on fooling around, doing those novelty numbers with washboard, playing the horn, singing and jiving, that kind of stuff until years passed in between. And Lester Melrose come along. We know him too, because he used to deal with Jell-O'-Morton during the time when I was fooling around with Jell-O, way back in the early 20s. So me and Mr. Melrose got together and got to talking. And so I said, Mr. Melrose, I said, I've got a lot of good stuff I know that could sell. He said, well what is it buddy? I said,…
